name: pin-ignore
assumes: A placed part's pin; a section of a package with several devices never takes PACK_SHORT, since there an ignored slot is a pad that section lacks. Ignored means its device pin flag has bit 7 (Pin Ignore) in the pin map that supplied its number; PACK_SHORT is the library part's property listing pins shorted in the package (docs/cadence-dsn-format.md §5.8).
